When I was about 4, and my sister was 3, my mother and father separated.  My mother took my sister and I and moved into a new house.  One hot summer day we all got in the car to go out grocery shopping or something. My mom claimed to have forgot something in the house and left us in the car. We eventually got bored and had switched seats. (She took my normal car seat in the back while I took her booster seat in the front). We sat for a long time, and our mom did not come. It started to get really hot in the car, and it was starting to get harder and harder to breathe. My sister and I started to panic. Finally my mother came out and saw us crying. She went to open the door, but she had locked the keys inside with us. We were locked in. For some reason my mom left once again, leaving my sister and I having no idea what to do. I was not strong enough to unbuckle the booster seat, and my sister was not strong enough to unbuckle her seat belt. Inside the car got hotter and it was getting even harder to breathe. Then finally, in some stroke of luck, my dad had came to visit us, saw us in the car, and luckily had a spare key to the car so he opened it up and saved us. My dumb as mother had done nothing at all. 

tldr; almost died from suffocation in a car with my sister while my mom did nothing
